Package org.apache.juneau.console

Class TopicDecl

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.TopicDecl
public final class TopicDecl extends Object
A custom topic declaration, for a card's publishes or the page's top-level topics.
Example:

// Published by this card's JS: card.publishes(TopicDecl.of("ssc.focus").retain(true)); // Published by a page script or the server: PageSpec.create().topic(TopicDecl.of("app.region-picked").retain(true) .publisher(TopicDecl.Publisher.SCRIPT));

Since:
10.0.0
